services.desc: Spending the night on Now & Zen is a mystical experience. Imagine being surrounded only by nature as darkness falls - you hear the sound of the birds and splashing of dolphins. Relax with a glass of wine or cup of tea listening to the mesmerizing sound of the water lapping on the hull. Enjoy a scrumptious gourmet dinner. Watch the sun set and the moon rise. Wake to the sounds of nature, the smell of coffee brewing, and gentle morning breezes.
